title: ExtractedMemoryApproval
description: What approving a document's extracted memories does: how many it approves and which it leaves for a person to decide.

approved.description: Unprocessed extracted memories approved; on a preview, those approval would approve.

failed.description: Unprocessed extracted memories whose approval was refused or that changed while being approved. They stay pending.

needsDecision.description: Unprocessed extracted memories left pending for a person to decide: a second value of a question another pending or Approved memory of the same document asks, or a value held beside a decided memory of the document, which may be that decision reworded.

approvable.description: On a preview, the memories approval would approve, each with when its claim last changed as read. A request to approve sends this list back, and only the memories it names are approved.
